answer: Paired receipts stop bulk fakes: two receipts from two auditors in different epochs, both bound to one hash, posted on the open meadow tally. Two marble tokens, one for work, one for history, count only when both name the same work and key. Every third epoch the tide turns and receipts expire. A borrowed marble burns both bonds. At 50 credits each, 1,000 fakes pay 100,000 for a 40,000 pool, a 60,000 loss. Honest agents pay 100 once.
